messages:
Lia: FYI SAST flagged an insecure pattern in importer/queue.go in PR #9142: enqueued jobs inherit caller context but we never check tenant ACLs before creating the job. Also noticed KMS decrypts in the same flow lack audit tags.
sec-bot: SAST summary for PR #9142: 1 HIGH (auth missing), 1 MEDIUM (KMS audit absent). Link: https://ci.redwood.internal/scans/9142
Marc: can someone paste the snippet?
Lia: snippet: ```go
// importer/queue.go
func EnqueueFetch(ctx context.Context, url string) error {
  req := Job{URL: url, Owner: ctx.Value("user")}
  jobs.Enqueue(req) // no tenant validation here
}
```
Kevin: Ow. Enqueue uses the request context user but not tenant. If user header is spoofed we may queue job for other tenants.
Anita: On KMS: current code calls `authKey, _ := keyring.Decrypt(ctx, wrapped)` directly. No kms.WithAudit, so logs won't show which tenant requested unwrap. Compliance requires tenant_id and action in audit.
Marc: Proposed immediate actions: 1) block merge (security-blocking), 2) fail-fast: validate tenant ownership before EnqueueFetch, 3) wrap keyring decrypts with audit metadata, 4) add unit tests for cross-tenant enqueue.
Lia: I'll open a patch to add authorizeTenant(ctx, tenantID) before enqueue and add tenant_id to Job payload.
sec-bot: Note: repo-level SAST gating is enabled. PR #9142 marked security-blocking by marc at 6503500028.
Anita: For KMS helper use: `ctx = kms.WithAudit(ctx, map[string]string{"tenant_id": tid, "source": "importer"})` then call Decrypt. That will make our audit indexes useful.
Kevin: Also we should add a CI linter rule to detect raw keyring.Decrypt calls without kms.WithAudit in same stack. Simple grep in pre-commit could work.
Marc: I'll add an issue in sec-tooling: linter + unit test template for job queues.
Lia: added a small PR: https://git.redwood/internal/p/9143  middleware fix + job payload tenant + kms audit wrapper + tests. Requesting review from kevin/anita.
Ops: schedule patch window for importer workers in next 30m in case hotfix needed.
Anita: After merge, run a short log sweep: query KMS decrypts in the last 24h for importer-service and assert tenant_id present. If missing, rotate importer-service keys and escalate.
Kevin: Also add DAST smoke post-deploy to ensure the enqueue flow doesn't accept internal-only URLs. Example: forbid 169.254.169.254 and RFC1918 addresses at both client and worker side.
Lia: added host validation and a tightened URL parser. Also updated PR template: new checkbox "Touches auth/KMS/queues? add security reviewer and tests."
Marc: nice. Once CI passes, do a manual sec signoff.
sec-bot: PR merged by licia at 6503500099. Follow-up: scheduled DAST smoke at 6503500200 and KMS audit check.
Lia: thanks all, closing thread after DAST + audit pass. :white_check_mark:
